newsitem.title: UK: HARLOW BUTLER TAKES STAKE IN S.AFRICA'S FCB.
newsitem.headline: HARLOW BUTLER TAKES STAKE IN S.AFRICA'S FCB.

text.p: Harlow Butler is expanding its South African operations further by taking a major shareholding in Financial Currency Brokers (FCB), a leading money and securities broking company in Johannesburg, Harlow Butler said in a statement.

The expansion will give customers in South Africa direct access to liquidity in South African products, all internationally traded currencies and the emerging market currencies covered by Harlow Butler in London and Harlow Meyer Savage in New York.

FCB-Harlow Butler has 35 brokers in Johannesburg. The team covers spot and forward foreign exchange and local money markets and is linked to Harlow's desk in London. In securities broking, 10 FCB-Harlow Butler brokers are linking with Harlow Butler's sister company Garban, which has created a new desk to cover South African government bonds.
